description: Batch 2. Gaps found by probing the parser with commands that are not in batch 1: history-rewriting git subcommands and the POSIX filesystem root. Both were passing silently.

cases.note: POSIX filesystem root. Batch 1 only recognised Windows drive roots, so this passed. No stated reason makes this acceptable.
Control: recursive delete with a scoped target must not be denied. It lands in the why layer instead.
Overwrites remote history. Legitimate on a personal branch often enough that deny would be wrong, destructive enough that silence is worse.
Discards working-tree changes without a reflog path back to them.
Removes untracked files, including ignored build output that may be unreproducible.
Control: an ordinary push must not be caught. Only history rewriting needs a stated reason.
